arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
from PIL import Image
from collections import Counter
im = Image.open('/root/workspace/home/Desktop/IMG_4913.jpg').convert('RGB')
w, h = im.size
def band(y0_frac, y1_frac, x0_frac=0.20, x1_frac=0.80):
    x0, x1 = int(w*x0_frac), int(w*x1_frac)
    y0, y1 = int(h*y0_frac), int(h*y1_frac)
    pix = [im.getpixel((x, y)) for y in range(y0, y1, 6) for x in range(x0, x1, 6)]
    pix = [p for p in pix if max(p) - min(p) > 12 and (p[0] + p[1] + p[2]) < 720]
    return Counter(pix).most_common(1)[0][0] if pix else None
def hx(rgb):
    return '#{:02X}{:02X}{:02X}'.format(*rgb)
print('title band  ~y 0.05-0.14 :', hx(band(0.05, 0.14)))
print('key result  ~y 0.19-0.24 :', hx(band(0.19, 0.24)))
print('methods hdr ~y 0.28-0.33 :', hx(band(0.28, 0.33)))
print('affil line  ~y 0.37-0.42 :', hx(band(0.37, 0.42)))
PY
